title: Expert briefings and decision boundaries
acceptance: Define reusable expert briefings with worked examples.
Define delegated decisions and triggers for human escalation.
Demonstrate a routine contribution without a per-step human gate and a consequential decision that stays pending until reviewed.
non_goals: No production component rewrite or deployment.
No private data or unauthorized external testing.

title: Refine the common specification contract
acceptance: Review the initial Markdown/JSON templates and schemas with alternatives.
Define versioning and stable requirement IDs with a worked example.
Explain how domain-specific extensions preserve common acceptance traceability.
non_goals: No production component rewrite or deployment.
No private data or unauthorized external testing.

title: Independent verification and CI trust boundaries
acceptance: Define builder/verifier separation and protected acceptance criteria.
Map unit, property, conformance, fuzzing, static analysis, formal, QEMU and hardware checks to risks.
Show how an untrusted PR is assessed without production secrets or executing its acceptance checker.
non_goals: No production component rewrite or deployment.
No private data or unauthorized external testing.

title: Reproducible evidence and result states
acceptance: Define exact revision, environment, commands, artifacts and requirement mapping.
Distinguish proposed, measured, independently reproduced and formally proved claims.
Provide valid and invalid evidence examples and tests for rejection.
non_goals: No production component rewrite or deployment.
No private data or unauthorized external testing.

title: Performance benchmark methodology
acceptance: Define workloads, hardware, p50/p99 latency, throughput, memory, CPU and cost accounting.
Document baseline selection, warmup, repetitions and uncertainty.
Supply a reproducible synthetic benchmark plan without fabricated measurements.
non_goals: No production component rewrite or deployment.
No private data or unauthorized external testing.

title: Data preservation and skipped-version upgrades
acceptance: Use the spec and evidence templates for a stateful migration/restore boundary.
Cover interrupted conversion, multiple skipped versions, old readers, backups and downgrade policy.
Specify a negative-case matrix and returning-device remediation isolation.
non_goals: No production component rewrite or deployment.
No private data or unauthorized external testing.

title: Review task claiming and abandoned-work recovery
acceptance: Exercise the initial claim bot with competing claims, renewal, expiry and submitted PRs.
Identify API-failure, stale-label and concurrency failure modes with reproductions.
Propose narrowly scoped improvements backed by regression tests.
non_goals: No production component rewrite or deployment.
No private data or unauthorized external testing.

title: Exercise onboarding with a DNS parser specification
acceptance: Write a bounded stateless DNS message parsing spec with exact RFC sections.
Map every requirement to positive and negative planned checks using the evidence template.
Complete claim, fresh checkout, validation, fork PR, submission and local handoff; do not claim an implementation exists.
non_goals: No production component rewrite or deployment.
No private data or unauthorized external testing.

title: Returning contributors and opt-in scheduling
acceptance: Document resumption from an ignored handoff and existing review feedback.
Provide runner-neutral scheduling guidance with owner-approved budget, expiry and stop controls.
Demonstrate no-work, budget-exhausted and permission-required exits without spam or automatic enrollment.
non_goals: No production component rewrite or deployment.
No private data or unauthorized external testing.

title: Adversarial fixtures for contribution checks
acceptance: Add cases for stale spec versions, missing coverage, false measured claims and unsafe paths.
Show the same checks rejecting bad fixtures and accepting corrected fixtures.
Document structural validation limits and propose the next independent checker boundary.
non_goals: No production component rewrite or deployment.
No private data or unauthorized external testing.

title: Move coordination tooling and onboarding to Rust
acceptance: Replace the document checker, task listing, claim service and seeding with Rust; remove Node/npm contributor prerequisites.
Preserve baseline validation and lease behavior, add same-account session isolation, and document what runs locally versus on GitHub.
Repeat a fresh fork contribution and negative/positive evidence checks, plus real session-aware claim/submission checks; record exact revisions and results.
non_goals: No production component rewrite or deployment.
No private data or unauthorized external testing.
